lessons.title: Practice Smart Pointers RAII
lessons.description: Use std::unique_ptr and RAII patterns for automated memory management. Implement makeHeapInt(int value) returning a std::unique_ptr<int> that owns a heap-allocated copy of value; prefer the std::make_unique factory. The test checks that !ptr || *ptr equals 42.

tests.name: test_unique_ptr
tests.unittest_code:
auto ptr = makeHeapInt(42);
if (!ptr || *ptr != 42) throw std::runtime_error("Smart pointer failed");
